metadata.title: Groupicorn Indiana IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Indiana is represented by an initial regional catchment pair; remaining leads stay in the verification queue until exact-site evidence is checked. September 22, 2026 added an Indianapolis discovery pass with official-site PHP/IOP records for Recovery Centers of America, Valle Vista Health System, Avenues Recovery, and Indiana Teen Treatment Centers. Community Health Network Lawrence Township and Shadeland were also retained from the official clinic directory; Fort Wayne records were not statewide-refreshed.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset. Existing asset provenance and license clearance require separate review where source URLs are not yet recorded.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.
metadata.generation_note: Generated from source/areas and source/providers by tools/directory.py; edit canonical source files rather than this artifact.

research_queue.name: Indianapolis platform discovery leads
research_queue.task: Yelp was blocked by robots.txt, so no Yelp claims were used. Psychology Today leads included Evolve Indy, Avenues Recovery, Indy Teen Treatment Center, Hendricks Behavioral Hospital, Caring Associates, Firefly Children and Family Alliance, Indianapolis Comprehensive Treatment Center, Thrive Mental Health, Care to Change, and Resource Treatment Center: Avenues and ITTC were verified and published; Evolve, Hendricks, and Caring Associates remain queued; Firefly and Care to Change showed general counseling rather than verified IOP/PHP; Indianapolis CTC is opioid MAT rather than strict IOP/PHP; Thrive was virtual-only; Resource Treatment Center described referrals rather than a current local IOP/PHP. Reddit surfaced IU Health, Community, and St. Vincent leads; IU Health remains logo-pending and Community is already represented. SAMHSA/Indiana public-directory searches produced address and level-of-care leads used only for corroboration.
